move: feature cards rise with tilt and overshoot, shine sweeps, float, lift out
how: On a warm stage with two slowly rotating colour blobs, a headline rises from a mask (expo.out) and a subline follows. Three feature cards in a grid rise from y 260 with rotateX -28 and individual z-rotations, scale 0.86 and opacity 0, landing with back.out(1.6) over 1s at 140ms stagger from 5% of the 5s loop. Inside each, the icon spins in from scale 0 (back.out(2.5)), the two-line heading rises from masks (60ms stagger), the paragraph fades up and the tag pill pops with back.out(3). From 32% a diagonal shine gradient sweeps across each card (xPercent -80 to 80, power2.inOut, 150ms stagger). During the hold the cards float up 10px and back (sine.inOut yoyo). At 87% the cards lift up 60px, shrink to 0.94 and fade with power3.in at 80ms stagger, and the header fades.
adapt: Replace the three headings, paragraphs, tags and icon shapes, the card colours and blob gradients; card count works with the grid. Keep the back.out(1.6) 1s rise at 140ms stagger and the shine timing.
port: mount(el, shot) builds blobs, header and the card grid inside el (perspective on el). animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with labels at fractions of D; the per-card rotate array should be sized to shot.cards.length.
caveats: from() tweens throughout; set immediateRender:false if the timeline is built after first paint
last frame is empty stage, not the first frame
